historical_basis.quote: In Catalan mythology an aloja ... also known as dona d'aigua, goja or paitida, is a feminine being that lives in places with fresh water. These "water-women" are said to be able to turn into water blackbirds.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Katalan, aloja (juga dona d'aigua, goja, atau paitida) adalah makhluk perempuan yang tinggal di tempat berair tawar dan konon dapat menjelma menjadi burung air (dipper).
statement.en: In Catalan mythology an aloja (also dona d'aigua, goja or paitida) is a female being living where there is fresh water, said to be able to turn into a water blackbird (dipper).

historical_basis.quote: According to myth, water-women are nocturnal; have shimmering gold or red hair, and emerald or deep blue eyes; wear fine, rich clothes; and enjoy viewing their reflections in lakes on full-moon nights.

statement.id: Mereka makhluk malam berambut emas atau merah berkilau, bermata hijau zamrud atau biru tua, berpakaian indah, dan suka bercermin di danau pada malam bulan purnama.
statement.en: They are nocturnal, with shimmering gold or red hair and emerald or deep blue eyes, wear fine clothes and like to see their reflection in lakes on full-moon nights.
